comment: Golden vectors for the K2 Compute build statement format, https://github.com/Alakazam-211/K2/blob/main/docs/provenance-v1.md. A copy of tests/release/fixtures/provenance-v1.json in that repository, so this crate's tests run on their own; only this comment differs. TEST KEY ONLY: the node key below signs nothing real. Each vector: a plan, its node-signed receipt (domain k2-compute-receipt-v1), the node's own facts, and the in-toto statement they give, written from the spec; payload = its canonical JSON; the envelope is DSSE, ECDSA P-256 SHA-256 DER over the PAE (randomized: verify it, don't compare it). Written with openssl by tests/release/fixtures/make-provenance-v1.py in that repository, which shares no code with this crate.
